title: Multigenerational Family, Boys in Overalls - Vintage 1940s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor portrait of a multigenerational American family standing in the yard of a light-colored clapboard house. An elderly woman wearing glasses, a knit button-up cardigan, and a midi skirt stands beside a younger mother holding a baby in a printed dress. Two young boys wearing denim overalls and t-shirts pose in the foreground on the grass, one looking directly at the camera and the other gazing upward. In the background, a flat rural or newly developed suburban landscape stretches into the distance, reflecting post-WWII American family life.
